content.value_statement: Trend-based content pipelines often require repeated manual handoffs between discovery, drafting, and review. This skill coordinates the Defou Workflow Agent modules into one guided workflow.
actual_capabilities: Coordinates the content generation engine for TopHub trend intake.
Selects the top ten topics with stated viral potential.
Generates drafts in the Defou x Stanley content style.
Passes generated drafts into the viral verification workflow.
Scores drafts across six viral content factors.
Directs final posts to the viral-verified output directory.
limitations: Requires the surrounding Defou Workflow Agent project and scripts.
Depends on the parent project's global .env configuration.
Does not include standalone implementation code in this skill directory.
Targets one specific content workflow and writing style.

use_cases.title: Turn Trends Into Drafts
use_cases.description: Run a structured workflow that converts current hot topics into reviewed article drafts.

use_cases.title: Review Viral Potential
use_cases.description: Apply the verification step to score draft content across six viral factors.

use_cases.title: Operate a Content Pipeline
use_cases.description: Coordinate trend intake, draft generation, verification, and final output folders from one skill.

faq.question: What does this skill orchestrate?
faq.answer: It coordinates trend discovery, draft generation, viral verification, and final output placement.

faq.question: Does it include the workflow implementation?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes orchestration for scripts and modules in the parent Defou Workflow Agent project.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it need environment variables?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill states that it reuses the parent project's global .env configuration.

faq.question: Where are final posts saved?
faq.answer: The skill directs users to the viral-verified output directory in the Defou Workflow Agent project.

faq.question: Is human review still needed?
faq.answer: Yes. Generated and verified posts should be reviewed before publication.
